INSERT IGNORE INTO books ( title, author, publisher, isbn, price, stock, image_url, description, published_date, is_popular, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
( #{item.title}, #{item.author}, #{item.publisher}, #{item.isbn}, #{item.price}, #{item.stock}, #{item.imageUrl}, #{item.description}, #{item.publishedDate}, #{item.isPopular}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE books b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT book_id FROM order_items WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY book_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ) popular_list ON b.id = popular_list.book_id SET b.is_popular = (CASE WHEN popular_list.book_id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END) WHERE b.is_popular = true OR popular_list.book_id IS NOT NULL
